testcase.name: Scenario: Navigate through a staged separator with arrow keys: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1672:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Navigate through a staged separator with arrow keys ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And ribbon customization is open in the MCAD Software for the Part Tools target ✔ And the target contains "Cancel Sketch", a separator, and "Finish Sketch" in that order ✔ When the user selects "Cancel Sketch" in the target list ✔ And the user presses Down ✔ Then the separator is highlighted ✔ When the user presses Down again ✔ Then "Finish Sketch" is highlighted ✔ When the user presses Up ✔ Then the separator is highlighted ✔ And the staged rows remain in their original order ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes without applying the staged entries
